meta.title: Open BIM Suite — OpenAEC Foundation
meta.description: Open BIM Suite is the all-in-one program for BIM: Viewer, Modeller and Validator in one application. Standalone tools, each with its own installer, are released from the Suite as well.

header.label: Coming soon · BIM
header.desc: The all-in-one program for BIM: viewing, modelling and checking in one application. Standalone tools, each with its own installer, are released from the Suite as well.

what.title: One program with everything in it
what.p1: Open BIM Suite is a collection tool. Everything we build for BIM comes together in one program: you open a model, view it, update it and check it, without switching programs. At the top right you switch between the parts.
what.alt: Open BIM Suite in the dark theme with the IFC model of an apartment building, and at the top right the switch between Viewer, Modeller and Validator

parts.title: What is in it today
parts.viewer: Open and view IFC, IFCX and other models, with sections, measurements and properties.
parts.modeller: Create and edit a model: walls, floors, columns and other building elements.
parts.validator: Check models: test them against IDS and the NL-BIM Basis ILS, find clashes and record issues in BCF.

tools.title: Standalone tools with their own installer
tools.p1: Not everyone needs everything. That is why standalone tools are released from the Suite too. It is the same code, but each tool contains only its own part and has its own, smaller installer. A new version of the Suite also produces a new version of the standalone tools.
tools.viewer: Just the Viewer: open and view models, with its own installer for Windows, macOS and Linux.
tools.validator: Just the Validator: check models against IDS and look for clashes. The first standalone release is on its way.
tools.modeller: The Modeller is only in the Suite for now. A standalone version will follow later.

choose.title: Suite or standalone tool?
choose.suiteWhy: if you work with models from viewing to checking, and want everything in one program.
choose.toolWhy: if you only need one thing, such as just viewing models, or want a smaller installation on a computer you share with others.
